title: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
prompt: Given an array of integers heights representing the histogram's bar height where the width of each bar is 1, return the area of the largest rectangle in the histogram.
hints: For each bar, the largest rectangle with that bar as height extends until we hit a shorter bar on either side.
Use a monotonically increasing stack. When we see a bar shorter than stack top, the stack top's right boundary is found. Left boundary is the new stack top.
Width = right - left - 1. Area = height * width. Handle stack empty for left boundary (use -1).
Add 0 at the end to force pop of all remaining bars. O(n) time.
